snippet.title: Iman | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529210/Iman

IMAN is a 2D adventure-horror game. Step into the shoes of devout Rudi in this Indonesian pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming. Uncover the dark mysteries, heal the possessed, and use faith to survive supernatural encounters against demonic forces.

Press kit: https://www.notion.so/Iman-Press-Kit-35e1f9c97aee801497d2c14f234b7cc5
